rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
rules.description: Untrusted CR or LF characters are not neutralized before use in line-delimited protocol metadata.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.

rules.cwe_name: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password
rules.description: Using the HTTP Host header to construct a link in an email can facilitate phishing attacks and leak password reset tokens.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS)
rules.description: A string transformer that does not replace or escape all occurrences of a meta-character may be ineffective.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
rules.description: Prepending a backslash to an ordinary character in a string does not have any effect, and may make regular expressions constructed from this string behave unexpectedly.

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: An assignment to a local variable that is not used later on, or whose value is always overwritten, has no effect.

rules.cwe_name: Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type ('Type Confusion')
rules.description: Sanitizing an HTTP request parameter may be ineffective if the user controls its type.

rules.cwe_name: Protection Mechanism Failure
rules.description: The Helmet middleware is used to set security-related HTTP headers in Express applications. This query finds instances where the middleware is configured with important security features disabled.

rules.cwe_name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
rules.description: Making a client-to-server request with user-controlled data in the URL allows a request forgery attack against the client.

rules.cwe_name: Creation of Temporary File With Insecure Permissions
rules.description: Creating a temporary file that is accessible by other users can lead to information disclosure and sometimes remote code execution.
